answer: Resist sybils with a sealed heartbeat radio bound to one disclosed site per identity. Unpredictable challenge pings use distance-bounding, so a remote clone arrives too late and is dropped. Each extra fake identity must deploy another sealed radio at another unique site; one box cannot answer two pings in one window, and a warehouse farm cannot share a single location. Auditors place the pinger in person, even beside a vine where a sparrow nests above the wharf, so the visit cannot be bulk-bought or parallelized from a cloud rack.
